title: A directional zero–one law under strict ellipticity
summary: We prove the directional zero–one conjecture for nearest-neighbor random walks in independent and identically distributed strictly elliptic environments on ℤ d , d ≥ 3: the probability of escape in each fixed nonzero real direction is zero or one. Only strict positivity of the transition probabilities is required; no uniform lower bound or moment assumption is imposed.
family_title: Directional zero–one laws beyond iid environments and iid ballisticity

review.reason: Proves the directional zero-one conjecture for random walks in strictly elliptic i.i.d. environments.
